item.noTitle: No title in this language: this item is left out of lists and has no heading.

image.noTitle: This image has no title in the media library, so it has no alternative text.

richText.headingsRenumbered: This text's headings use level 1, or skip a level: they are shown renumbered so the page outline stays whole. Start the text's main parts at Heading 2 and go down one level at a time.
richText.imageWithoutAlt: An image in this text has no alternative text: it is ignored by screen readers.
richText.tableWithoutCaption: A table in this text has no caption: give it one so that it can be found and understood.

cta.noTarget: No link target in this language
cta.noLink: This button has a label but no link: choose a page or a web address, or clear the label.

summary.picked: Shows the {{shown}} picked products, in their order.
summary.shop: Shows {{shown}} of the {{found}} products of the shop folder, with the Shopify tag “{{tag}}” when one is set.
summary.shopMissing: The shop folder is set but cannot be found (deleted, or the connector is not configured): nothing shows on the live site.
summary.none: Pick products, or choose a shop folder to read them from.

brand.noTitle: This brand spotlight has no brand name in this language: it is not shown.

gift.noTitle: This gift offer has no name in this language: it is not shown.
gift.ended: This offer has ended: visitors no longer see it. Change its last day or remove it.

look.noTitle: This look has no name in this language: it is not shown.
